notes: v7.4.0 — Super Feature Release. (1) Song Library & Accounts Phase 1: sha256 passwords, AuthProvider, SongLibraryProvider, LoginPage with guest mode, SongLibrary UI with engine tabs + albums + favorites + search/sort + bulk ZIP/JSON export + auto-migration from history + AlbumDetail page + /api/auth + /api/albums + /api/songs backend endpoints. (2) Remix Studio A/B side-by-side compare with engine re-master selection on history cards. (3) Publish Studio advanced exports: bitrate selector 192/256/320 + Lossless, JSZip bundle (MP3+cover+metadata.json+lyrics.txt+caption.txt+MANUAL_UPLOAD_STEPS.md), .lrc lyrics export with evenly distributed timestamps, ID3 info panel, vertical 1080x1920 video toggle for short-form platforms. (4) AUTO Strategy Presets wired: StrategySelector inside AutoCreativePanel, selectedStrategyId persisted via getAutoConfig/setAutoConfig, applyStrategyPreset() applied in Muse/Suno/Melo AUTO start + 40s creative ideation snapshot as baseline defaults with explicit values overriding. (5) Song Quality Analyzer: 6-metric heuristic 1-100 scoring (structural×0.15 + lyrics×0.25 + duration×0.15 + bpm×0.15 + style×0.15 + clarity×0.15), QualityScoreBadge pill, useQualityGate threshold hook, standalone analyzer page with regen slider. (6) Persistent Bottom Audio Player + PlayerContext: global glassmorphism bottom bar with MediaSession API integration (metadata, position state, 7 action handlers), prev/next/seek/volume/shuffle/repeat controls, expandable 16:9 mini-player with animated waveform + lyrics excerpt scroller, playNext/playPrev/enqueue singleton Audio. (7) Batch Generation: manual textarea or CSV/JSON upload with built-in parser, engine checkboxes, strategy preset, sequential queue with per-item cards + global status (queued/running/done/failed) + ETA calculation from first-job average, ZIP bundle output with MP3 + cover + metadata. (8) Analytics Dashboard: 4 KPI cards + 4 inline SVG/CSS charts (engine comparison bars, style donut with conic-gradient, 7×24 productive-hours heatmap, 7-day polyline area trend) from localStorage history, publishing metrics, Top-5 habits list, CSV report export. (9) Wiring: Dashboard sidebar Workbench group (Library/Quality/Batch/Analytics) + Login/Logout auth button with user.name; Dashboard landing 4-card Workbench quick access row; App.jsx lazy loads for LoginPage/SongLibrary/AlbumDetail/QualityAnalyzerPage/BatchGenerationPage/AnalyticsPage; AppWithProviders wrapped AuthProvider> SongLibraryProvider> PlayerProvider> GenerationProvider> AutoProgressProvider; PersistentAudioPlayer globally mounted. (10) i18n: 150+ new keys added with 8 namespace prefixes (library, auth, remix, publish_export, strategy, quality, player, batch, analytics) + 8 nav keys, en.json/zh.json perfectly synchronized with zero mixed CN/EN.
